docs.title: Mr. FPGA Stream Deck
docs.text:
Live Mr. FPGA status, system health, RetroAchievements, and one-press controls.

  • Install
  • Usage
  • Features & data sources
  • Development
  • Troubleshooting

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
• src/core — types, formatting, SVG rendering (pure, unit-tested).
  • src/mrfpga — REST / SSH / RetroAchievements clients (parsers unit-tested).
  • src/actions — Stream Deck SDK glue (thin).
  • assets + scripts/render-icons.mjs — icon design and PNG generation.

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
npm test          # vitest run
npm run build     # rollup → com.hudsonbrendon.mrfpga.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js
npm run watch     # rebuild on change
npm run icons     # regenerate icons
npm run pack      # produce a .streamDeckPlugin in dist/

docs.title: Debugging
docs.text: npx streamdeck restart com.hudsonbrendon.mrfpga after a build. Logs at com.hudsonbrendon.mrfpga.sdPlugin/logs/*.log. If a rebuild isn't picked up, fully relaunch the plugin process.

docs.title: Features & data sources
docs.text: All data comes from your own Mr. FPGA / accounts — no third-party service.

docs.title: Now Playing (REST)
docs.text: GET http://<host>:8182/api/sysinfo + /games/playing → current core, game, and hostname. A green dot means the Mr. FPGA answered; OFFLINE means it didn't.

docs.title: System (SSH)
docs.text: A single SSH probe reads /tmp/CORENAME, /proc/uptime, /proc/loadavg, and /proc/meminfo, yielding CPU load (1m), RAM used %, and uptime. Requires the SSH user/password (stock Mr. FPGA: root / 1). Mr. FPGA exposes no temperature sensor, so none is shown.

docs.title: RetroAchievements (Web API)
docs.text: API_GetUserRankAndScore.php + API_GetUserRecentlyPlayedGames.php from retroachievements.org → hardcore points, global rank, and the completion % of your most recently played game. Requires your RA username and a Web API key from retroachievements.org/settings.

docs.title: Control (REST)
docs.text:
One key, configurable per instance:

Action Endpoint Reboot POST /settings/system/reboot Menu POST /launch/menu Screenshot POST /screenshots Volume + / − POST /controls/keyboard/volume_up / volume_down Launch POST /games/launch with { "path": "…" }

docs.title: Security
docs.text: The mrext Remote API has no authentication — anyone on your LAN can call it. SSH and RA credentials are stored in the plugin's Stream Deck settings on this machine. Keep the Mr. FPGA on a trusted network.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Stream Deck app 6.5+
  • A Mr. FPGA running the mrext Remote service (:8182) on your LAN
  • Node.js 20+ — only if you build from source

docs.title: Option A — Install from a release (recommended)
docs.text:
1. Open the Releases page.
  2. Download the latest com.hudsonbrendon.mrfpga.streamDeckPlugin.
  3. Double-click it — the Stream Deck app installs it.
# or via the GitHub CLI
gh release download --repo hudsonbrendon/mr-fpga-stream-deck --pattern "*.streamDeckPlugin"
open com.hudsonbrendon.mrfpga.streamDeckPlugin

docs.title: Option B — From source
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/hudsonbrendon/mr-fpga-stream-deck
cd mr-fpga-stream-deck
npm install && npm run icons && npm run build
npx streamdeck link com.hudsonbrendon.mrfpga.sdPlugin
npx streamdeck restart com.hudsonbrendon.mrfpga

docs.title: Configure
docs.text: Add the keys, then in any key's Property Inspector set the Mr. FPGA IP / host. For the System key add SSH credentials (stock: root / 1); for RetroAchievements add your RA username + Web API key. See Usage.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text: Symptom Cause / fix Key shows mrfpga setup No Mr. FPGA host set. Add the IP in the Property Inspector. Now Playing shows OFFLINE Mr. FPGA unreachable on :8182. Check the IP, that it's powered on, and that the mrext Remote service is running. System key shows system error SSH failed. Check user/password/port (stock root/1/22) and that SSH is enabled on the Mr. FPGA. RetroAchievements shows retro setup or error Missing/invalid RA username or Web API key (get the key at retroachievements.org/settings). Control key does nothing / flashes ✗ No host set, or the action failed — see logs/*.log. Launch needs a valid Launch path. Key stuck on default image The plugin process didn't reload — remove/re-add the key, or npx streamdeck restart com.hudsonbrendon.mrfpga.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
Add any of the four keys from the Mr. FPGA Stream Deck category.

┌────────────┐ ┌────────────┐ ┌────────────┐ ┌────────────┐
│ ●          │ │   SYSTEM   │ │   RETRO    │ │  Mr. FPGA  │
│    SNES    │ │ LOAD  0.42 │ │   12345    │ │            │
│ Chrono Tr… │ │ RAM    38% │ │ pts · #678 │ │   REBOOT   │
│  Mr. FPGA  │ │ ▓▓▓▓░░░░░  │ │    25%     │ │            │
│            │ │ UP    3d4h │ │ ▓▓▓░░░░░░  │ │            │
└────────────┘ └────────────┘ └────────────┘ └────────────┘
  Now Playing      System        RetroAch.       Control
  • Now Playing — current core + game; green dot = online, OFFLINE = unreachable.
  • System — CPU load (1m), RAM used %, and uptime (needs SSH). Show all three on one key, or split each onto its own key via the Metric setting (one big number per key).
  • RetroAchievements — hardcore points, rank, and current-game completion % (needs RA creds).
  • Control — press to run its action. Pick the action (and a launch path) in the Property Inspector.

Split the System key into three big, readable tiles:

┌────────────┐ ┌────────────┐ ┌────────────┐
│    LOAD    │ │    RAM     │ │   UPTIME   │
│            │ │            │ │            │
│    0.42    │ │    38%     │ │    3d4h    │
│            │ │ ▓▓▓▓░░░░░  │ │            │
└────────────┘ └────────────┘ └────────────┘
  Metric: Load   Metric: RAM   Metric: Uptime

Display keys auto-refresh on the interval (default 15s); tap to refresh now.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
• Metric (per System key) — All (load + RAM + uptime, default), Load, RAM, or Uptime (one large value).
  • Mr. FPGA IP / host, REST port (global) — the mrext Remote endpoint.
  • Refresh (sec) (global) — poll interval (default 15, min 5).
  • SSH user / password / port (global) — for the System key.
  • RA username / Web API key (global) — for the RetroAchievements key.
  • Action + Launch path (per Control key) — what that key does.
